name: house-style
description: a house style for everything your agents write for you: plain words, no jargon, no hype. edit it to make it yours.

house-style.text: when you write something the human will send or publish (a post, an email, a doc), use the house style: short sentences, plain words, active voice, no jargon, no hype words (unlock, leverage, seamless, delve), numbers as digits, and one idea per paragraph.
